# CANDIDATE: VIX_RISING_PUT_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

For bearish PUT setups, requiring VIX to be rising (positive 5-bar slope) at entry filters out false breakdowns that occur when options market is not pricing fear, thereby increasing win rate on J winner days while avoiding losers on days where VIX is falling.

## Mechanism

Add a filter in `evaluate_bearish_setup` that checks the 5-bar VIX slope (current VIX minus VIX 5 bars ago) > 0. Only allow PUT entries when slope > 0. No change to CALL side or other logic.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and 3-contract minimum.  
2. **Sample bias:** Proposal based on anecdotal observation of VIX behavior on J loser days (5/05-5/07) where VIX was flat/falling. Sample size = 3 loser days; overfit risk high without broader validation.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA slippage model not yet applied to filtered signals).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: if VIX rises sharply on a loser day, filter may inadvertently block a winning PUT entry (e.g., 5/04 if VIX rise misinterpreted). Max drawdown scenario: prolonged low-VIX regime causing chronic under-trading and opportunity cost. Blow-up scenario: none directly, but false sense of security could lead to increased position sizing.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.  

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators: `test_vix_rising_put_filter.py` must pass. Walk-forward: OOS Sharpe >= 0.70 and sub-window stability. Real-fills: diff < ±20% vs BS-sim on top 3 J days. Additionally, must not reduce edge_capture on J winner days below baseline.
